experiment: E5: refine the cw=4 win (rows, stages, threads)
method: msprof device time, vendor bracketed in the same window

results.name: r6_cw4
results.caveat: 8192 is not divisible by 64*6=384, so a literal rows=6 leaves 128 rows uncovered unless remainder handling is added; NOT adopted until that is proven correct

conclusion: rows=4 with cw=4 is the correct, divisible sweet spot at 0.1382 ms. rows=6 reads ~3% faster but is not divisible and not adopted. v3s3 and t128 do not help.
decision: KEEP rows=4 + coalesced_width=4 (1.18x vs the cw=1 baseline). rows=6 deferred pending remainder handling.
